control_driver_method: Load probe.py with importlib.util.spec_from_file_location; set umask 077. Each run uses tempfile.TemporaryDirectory and Lab.cleanup in finally.

Subclass Lab.wait: call super().wait(predicate, timeout) first. Inspect predicate.__code__.co_consts for output, z, or #{client_pid}:#{session_id}. Record the original true value and return False for exactly those three waits.

Subclass Lab.record to append sanitized case/status/observed rows without printing all rows. Call experiment(lab). Require exactly the three targeted rows fail and all other rows pass; print only the control result and targeted rows.
In a second private Lab, start new-session -d -P -F #{session_id} -s detach-control /bin/sleep 30 (startup=True), attach Client at 80x24 and await its exact client_pid.

Replace only that Client.send with lambda _data: None, dropping native detach input. Call close(); require termination in (pty-close, sigkill-fallback) and normal_detach_confirmed false. Print only that sanitized result.
